title: An Uncertainty-Aware Hybrid Mathematical-Machine-Learning Model for Smart Irrigation Decision Support
abstract: arXiv:2609.13864v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agriculture accounts for roughly 70% of global freshwater withdrawals, yet irrigation is still commonly scheduled reactively, with no forecast of where soil moisture is heading and no statement of confidence in that forecast. Data-driven models are accurate but opaque and point-valued; water-balance models are transparent but carry large structural error. Neither alone supports a defensible irrigation decision under uncertainty. This study coupled the two and carried uncertainty through to the decision: a four-parameter water-balance core, calibrated on training data only, was corrected by a Random Forest that learned nothing but the physical residual, conformal prediction attached 90%-nominal intervals, and a risk-aware rule converted the interval lower bound into an irrigation trigger. It was evaluated on three years of hourly in-situ measurements from a rainfed Mediterranean cropland station under a strict chronological split, scored

translated_title: 一种面向智慧灌溉决策支持的不确定性感知数学-机器学习混合模型
translated_abstract: 农业约占全球淡水取用量的70%，然而灌溉调度通常仍是被动响应式的，既不预测土壤湿度的未来走向，也不对该预测给出置信度说明。数据驱动模型精度高但不透明且仅提供点估计；水量平衡模型透明但带有较大的结构性误差。两者单独都无法在不确定性条件下支撑可辩护的灌溉决策。本研究将两者耦合，并将不确定性传递至决策环节：一个仅在训练数据上校准的四参数水量平衡核心，由一个只学习物理残差的随机森林进行校正，保形预测附加90%标称置信区间，再由一条风险感知规则将区间下界转化为灌溉触发条件。该模型在雨养地中海农田站点三年的逐小时现场实测数据上，采用严格的时间顺序数据划分进行了评估……
tldr: 该研究提出一种不确定性感知的数学-机器学习混合模型，将水量平衡核心与随机森林物理残差校正相耦合，结合保形预测置信区间和风险感知触发规则，实现了透明且可辩护的智慧灌溉决策支持。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an uncertainty-aware hybrid mathematical-machine-learning model that couples a four-parameter water-balance core with a Random Forest correcting only the physical residual, attaches conformal prediction intervals, and uses a risk-aware rule to convert the interval lower bound into an irrigation trigger for transparent and defensible smart irrigation decisions.
